findings.summary: The original `\b{end-half}` is a valid regex assertion matching what -w builds; the replacement `\{end-half}\b` is not a valid pattern, so the doc change is wrong.
The new line drops the roff escaping used on the line above, so the man page errors and --help shows the wrong text.

why: Finding 1 states the maintainer's reason in substance: the edit turns a valid pattern into an invalid one. Finding 2 is an extra, separate rendering problem.
